items.question: Which bounded local fallback can robustly preserve arbitrary/self-crossing/retraced freehand mill removal without the valid-but-wrong n-ary batching result or sampled-pose B-rep timeout behavior measured by RCS-011?
items.current_safe_policy: Use qualified explicit/canonical/segment strategies where applicable; constrain/contain pathological regions and refuse authoritative completion when no bounded fallback can preserve semantics.

items.question: How are real insert nose radius, orientation, grooving/parting and undercut envelopes generated and qualified inside the axisymmetric provider?
items.current_safe_policy: Keep the accepted provider subset limited to qualified rotationally symmetric envelopes and hand off/refuse unsupported operations.

items.question: Which concrete exporter build/profile and independent CAD/CAM consumer matrix will be qualified before production may claim STEP success?
items.current_safe_policy: Automated B-rep/write/read-back gates remain necessary but production export is interoperability_unqualified until the selected profile has current independent qualification.

items.question: How should non-orthogonal/curved fallback islands reconstruct exact/analytic boundaries and bound residual fitting error before STEP?
items.current_safe_policy: Prefer provenance-known analytic recovery; permit bounded fallbacks only where reconciliation can satisfy RCS-005, otherwise refuse export for that state.

items.question: Which OCCT Boolean/STEP paths are safely instance-local under conflicting concurrent jobs, and can worker-process isolation be relaxed?
items.current_safe_policy: Use process-isolated geometry workers with explicit per-call STEP parameters and timeouts. RCS-017 may narrow this boundary after measurement.

items.question: At realistic interactive workloads, how often do lathe/mill/provider transitions force expensive reconciliation and does this erase specialization benefits?
items.current_safe_policy: Make provider assumptions/capabilities explicit and cache reconciled checkpoints; measure handoff cost in production vertical slices.

items.question: Which concrete persistent ID/graph encoding, indexing and migration format should implement the accepted semantic-lineage model?
items.current_safe_policy: Preserve the semantic relation model and backend independence; choose serialization in production without exposing topology IDs.

items.question: What pending-state size/time/query thresholds force reconciliation before deferred topology becomes unbounded or stale?
items.current_safe_policy: Treat connectivity, exact topology queries, provider handoff and export as hard boundaries; add measured resource thresholds during implementation.

items.question: Which measured intersection/classification seams justify exact predicates/constructions, and which library/license choice is acceptable?
items.current_safe_policy: Do not blanket-rewrite with exact arithmetic; introduce it only at reproduced failure seams behind replaceable adapters.

items.question: What exact source/notice/relinking packaging is required for distributed OCCT-derived binaries and any optional third-party fallback dependencies?
items.current_safe_policy: Keep dependencies distinguishable, pinned and adapter-isolated; preserve licenses/notices/source provenance and perform a release compliance audit before distribution.

items.question: How should live-tool, eccentric and otherwise non-axisymmetric lathe operations dispatch without polluting the fixed-axis provider?
items.current_safe_policy: Reconcile and hand off to mill/general providers; do not approximate them inside the axisymmetric domain.
